Guess’ hardware starts tarnishing and my aldo bag began peeling. My thought is that if you’re spending 15k on a handbag it should give you atleast 2 years of good wear and not be made completely out of PU which is essentially plastic and functionally similar to a Zara handbag except for the branding. Please try brands like Da milano, tan and loom, and behno for a long lasting gift
